problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a critical circuit inspection across seven regional facilities.

The travel durations between facilities are recorded in minutes:
* Facility Alpha to Bravo: 111.2 minutes
* Alpha to Charlie: 162.5 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 35.4 minutes
* Alpha to Echo: 135.1 minutes
* Alpha to Foxtrot: 109.0 minutes
* Alpha to Golf: 167.3 minutes
* Bravo to Charlie: 108.1 minutes
* Bravo to Delta: 141.0 minutes
* Bravo to Echo: 118.1 minutes
* Bravo to Foxtrot: 173.3 minutes
* Bravo to Golf: 110.0 minutes
* Charlie to Delta: 173.0 minutes
* Charlie to Echo: 47.0 minutes
* Charlie to Foxtrot: 147.8 minutes
* Charlie to Golf: 5.4 minutes
* Delta to Echo: 137.6 minutes
* Delta to Foxtrot: 84.6 minutes
* Delta to Golf: 178.2 minutes
* Echo to Foxtrot: 101.2 minutes
* Echo to Golf: 52.2 minutes
* Foxtrot to Golf: 153.1 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection tour that visits every facility precisely once before concluding back at the initial facility.
